finding: No High-confidence picks for most sports
detail: Only one High pick was issued (Carolina Hurricanes). Minnesota Wild and Chemik Police W fell below the 70% probability bar and were kept at Medium. Every other market either failed the 70% probability test, fell outside the -250…+10000 fair-price window, or lacked an official source to price against. No tier was inflated to fill the five-per-sport quota.

finding: OLBG hub times are US Eastern, not UTC
detail: Hub times are rendered in US Eastern (UTC-4). NBA hub times were matched to the NBA calendar to fix the offset. Hub-derived starts are labelled 'derived' and are never presented as confirmed.
The OLBG golf hub returned 'No tips found' at capture; there was no golf market to attach a selection to.

finding: Rugby League hub has no fixture markets
detail: Only State of Origin 2027, Super League 2027 and NRL 2027 outrights were open. No match market existed, so no match pick could be made.

finding: Greyhound race times are internally inconsistent
detail: OLBG prints race names like '7:58 Doncaster' and renders the same race as 14:58 ET, a displacement. No independent GBGB card was read, so greyhound rows carry no verified start time and no price.

The NHL standings response contained Boston, Edmonton, Vegas and Carolina among its first records; San Jose, Toronto, St. Louis and other clubs were not in the readable portion, so their prices are opponent-blind and capped below High.
The NBA injury report PDF could not be read, so no availability or injury claim is made for any basketball game.

finding: Snooker head-to-head and ranking data not read
detail: The WST match list confirms the semi-final routing but no player ranking or head-to-head page was read, so the snooker pick is capped at Medium.

The brief asks for five written picks per sport per day. This desk issues far fewer because the evidence gate (official source + >70% probability + in-window price) is deliberately strict and no tier was invented to fill a quota.

finding: OLBG secondary routes return marketing copy
detail: OLBG 'All events' routes render tipster copy and 404 bodies in some cases. Only the sport hub listings were treated as usable discovery.
